notes.title: Overlooked dice-based roguelike Rollscape expands with meta-progression update
notes.content:
I'm always on the lookout for inventive, under-the-radar roguelikes, and I've just found one. With a focus on building overpowered dice combos, Rollscape has been quietly enjoying its time on Steam since 2024. But now it's just had its third major update, which is positively packed with content that reshapes how you play. So if you're looking for a new roguelike to try, Rollscape is absolutely for you.
Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Message to New Players: The 2500 Tiles Bug Fix
notes.content:
Welcome to all the new players!

First of all, thank you so much for giving the game a chance!

Secondly, I have been made aware of a bug that tells new players their best score is 2500 tiles. The same goes with the game thinking you already rolled a 20 before and thus receiving 2 achievements from the get go.

I'm truly very sorry for this and I can imagine it must have been extremely confusing to open your game in that state. It was a stupid coding mistake on my part and I can barely believe it really happened.


 For new players who haven't opened their game yet, the bug has now been fixed and you will never experience this.
 For new players who have already been playing, [strike]I'm working on a fix which I'm trying to get live asap (definitely still today)[/strike] the fix is now live. I will not be able to get your high score back if it less than 2500. In that case I will change the 2500 to 0 again, so you might be surprised to see a "New High Score" message popping up, even though you've already reached that distance before. Luckily, none of this has any impact on your progress.


Again, I'm very sorry for the inconvenience and I dearly hope it didn't ruin your first experience of the game.

Wishing you the best of luck in your coming runs!
Leonardo the Vinchy

notes.title: WELCOME TO A BRAND NEW ROLLSCAPE!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950742/1a074d5d1ab7277a08881aff9358b422776fa287.png

The time has come, we're looking at RollScape's third HUGE expansion!

Open up your game and embark on an epic adventure filled with meta-progression! collect all 50+ game modifiers like playing a run with a 20-sided die instead of a normal one, or starting your run with hundreds of points, in order to conquer the increasingly crazy trials.
In a special Free Play Mode, combine all your collected modifiers at the same time and witness... greatness.

What's more?

 All new Trials roguelite adventure + a massive battle pass reward system (no, there will never be microtransactions, you'll have to progress yourself)
 Very extended in-game Trials Maker to easily create & share your own trials with others. The possibilities are ENDLESS!
 Submit your own trials to get them featured in the brand new Community Trials tab
 Free Play Mode!
 New unlockable dice like a D20! I'm sure you can already come up with some insane synergies...
 Many new locations & way more new artifacts
 Completely new game mechanics (I won't spoil anything yet)
 DICE SKINS for all possible dice + tons of new tile skins & effects
 Of course, a bunch of new additions to the soundtrack
 ... and much more that you'll have to discover yourself!!

Just as a heads-up: most of these features need to be unlocked through the 'battle pass' first, so don't worry if you can't find something right away. You'll get there quickly.

NO MORE TIME TO WASTE. LET'S GET ROLLING!!

Cheers,
Leonardo the Vinchy

notes.title: ENDLESS IS COMING! (And so much more!)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950742/27cc9d8b685d6192b8d846b86c7752520c350be3.png

For those who have been following along in Discord, the next RollScape update has been in the works for three months now. Today, I am super excited to announce that it is finally releasing in less than 3 weeks from now, on the first of November 2024!


Without giving too much away, here’s a sneak peek at just SOME things you can expect in RollScape - Transcendence:


 Endless
 MANY New Locations and Artifacts
 Transcendence
 Artifact Challenges
 A brand-new Soundtrack for Transcendence, Endless and all the new locations
 Localization in 9 new languages (Japanese, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean and Dutch)
 And MUCH more that you'll quickly discover yourself!

As always, the Transcendence Update will be completely free for everyone!


Transcendence, to me, is more than just another update. I wanted it to be an experience. As such, I’ve poured all my creativity into this, creating a story for a game genre that hasn’t been done before.

The last three months have been stressful to say the least, but your support and understanding gave me so much motivation to keep working every single day. I’m truly incredibly grateful for the amazing Discord community that’s formed around the game. Anddd now that we are so close, I just can not wait to see all of your reactions to it!!

I also figured this special announcement would be the perfect time to reveal that there is now a RollScape x Genome Guardian Steam bundle available, granting you both games at a 30% discount!

See you soon!
Leonardo the Vinchy


With Transcendence coming up (and also because of the previous updates), RollScape's content will have grown massively since launch. These updates will always be free for everyone and I have a lot of ambition and motivation to keep creating many more. In order for me to be able to do that and also to better reflect the game's content in the price, I will increase the price of RollScape by $1 on October 25th.

notes.title: It's Time For RollScape's Biggest Update Yet!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950742/c8fcd4ae5f800c56364f308d9ffc93425d22138b.png

You're reading that right!
Yet another big update as we just passed the second week of RollScape's release.

We're looking at two completely new locations, each with their own cosmetics, music and artifacts. In addition to that, many of the existing locations have either been rebalanced or just gotten a complete rework altogether, introducing new artifacts as we say goodbye to others. And as always, many bugs have been rightfully exterminated.

Also, a new challenge is live right now so go and check it out! And the official Original Game Soundtrack will also release soon! It will include all music from the game and will be expanded upon when new music is added. You'll hear about it the moment it goes live.

Thank you so much again for all the support and I hope you enjoy!

This update is a big thanks to TimeToGrind, who has been of incredible support in this journey. One of the two new locations is designed in his theme. Definitely check out his channel on YouTube if you want to watch some truly awesome content (obviously watch his RollScape videos first).

notes.title: Control rebinds, new hotkeys, quick face selections, Mayhem improvements...
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950742/d91ebfe63eb53ba8dd44f3fd2b5e2decd3019449.png

Introduciiiing The QUALITY OF LIFE Update!


 Controls Menu located in the pause menu, where you can remap everything to whatever you want. So if you wanted to play mouse only or just want a more comfortable setup, now's the time.
 Dice Quick Selection hotkeys can be found in the controls menu too, so you can instantly skip the whole dice face selection. There's a button for highest, middle and lowest face.
 You can now also immediately confirm your dice selection by pressing the roll key.
 In addition to that, you now get a 1 second pause timer whenever dice upgrades pop up in Mayhem Timed.
 Mayhem no longer gives you multiplier curses until you reach shop tier 4 (the one that costs 500).
 Some more bugs fixed, and an improved screen resolution system.
 Cloud Saves are dropping tomorrow.


Some very special new content is coming next week. Not saying it's a new location, but it could definitely be one. And if so, it would be a very special one. And it would come with a new song too. And a new cosmetic. And of course a new artifact. And also...
